connectors.use_case: Drafting a module for a new-hire onboarding track, assigning a course to a department, reviewing completion rates before a manager check-in.

connectors.name: to-teach
connectors.description: Create classroom-ready worksheets, lessons and interactive activities from any topic or source—then share, collect responses or export.
connectors.use_case: Turning a news article into a worksheet for a middle school class, collecting student responses, exporting the results for grading.

connectors.name: Torah Library
connectors.description: Converts Hebrew dates, calculates zmanim and candle-lighting times, gives weekly Torah readings, and opens classic Jewish texts with commentaries in Hebrew and English.
connectors.use_case: Finding Shabbat candle-lighting time for a city, computing a yahrzeit date, preparing a parsha study pack with Rashi.

connectors.name: Traders'Hub
connectors.description: Lists Traders' Hub trading and investing courses with price, schedule and syllabus, shows free consultation times, books and cancels consultations, verifies certificates, and searches free articles.
connectors.use_case: Comparing Forex course schedules in Tbilisi, booking a free consultation for next week, verifying a graduate's certificate ID.

connectors.name: Training-360
connectors.description: Reads a company's Training-360 trainings, results and pass rates, certificates and their expiry, trainee feedback, assignments against due dates, learning paths and team views, with read-only access.
connectors.use_case: Listing forklift certificates that expire next month, checking who is behind on a site induction due Friday.

connectors.name: TrulyRandomVerse
connectors.description: Returns Bible verse text across many editions and languages, Strong's Hebrew and Greek word data, concordance occurrences, biblical persons, ranked cross-references, topical verses, Matthew Henry's commentary and early church fathers' writings.
connectors.use_case: Comparing a verse across translations, looking up the Greek word behind a phrase, reading what the church fathers wrote on a passage.

connectors.name: TTMI
connectors.description: Turns long text into visual sketches of complex systems and concepts with step-by-step guided walkthroughs, and saves, shares and exports sketches as PNG.
connectors.use_case: Turning a dense architecture document into a sketch to study, exporting a concept sketch as PNG for a slide.

connectors.name: Tuned In
connectors.description: Delivers a daily Portuguese-language edition of AI news with a concept of the day to learn, deeper dives on topics, past editions and logged spaced-repetition reviews.
connectors.use_case: Reading today's AI news edition, studying the concept of the day, logging a spaced review of an earlier concept.

connectors.name: Udemy Business
connectors.description: Searches Udemy Business courses, learning paths, lectures and labs for skill-building and reads the curriculum of a chosen course.
connectors.use_case: Finding a course on a skill needed for a project, checking a course's curriculum before starting, finding a hands-on lab.

connectors.name: UJJI AI
connectors.description: Calls UJJI AI workspace operations to create and organize training projects, courses and quizzes, manage LMS learning and SCORM packages, and pull engagement and progress analytics, confirming before any action that deletes or changes data.
connectors.use_case: Turning a warehouse safety SOP into a short course with a quiz, checking completion for new hires this month.

connectors.name: UmmahAPI
connectors.description: Searches and retrieves Quran verses and translations, Hadith collections, Tafsir commentary and duas, and returns prayer times and Qibla directions for given locations.
connectors.use_case: Looking up a Quran verse with its Tafsir, searching Hadith collections on a topic, finding prayer times and the Qibla direction while traveling.

connectors.name: Unclass MCP
connectors.description: Browses tutor courses and lessons, creates draft language lessons with exercises, word lists, videos and teacher notes, revises individual sections, duplicates and reorders lessons, pages and sections, and marks lessons ready, asking the user to approve authoring access the first time it changes content.
connectors.use_case: Drafting a Spanish lesson with fill-in-the-gap exercises, reordering pages before a class, duplicating a lesson for a new student group.

connectors.name: UnLethe
connectors.description: Reads vocabulary review schedules, stats and practice sessions, searches saved words, adds and updates words with translations, examples and tags, and records quiz or story practice results.
connectors.use_case: Checking which words are due for review, adding ten new words with example sentences, running a quiz on tagged words and saving the score.

connectors.name: uNotes
connectors.description: Searches the uNotes library of university notes, past exams, assignments and lab reports by school and course, reads documents, and lists flashcards, quizzes, study streak and quota.
connectors.use_case: Finding past thermodynamics exams for a second-year course, reading lecture 7 notes before a quiz.

connectors.name: UPSC Planner
connectors.description: Searches published UPSC and NCERT multiple-choice practice collections by subject, textbook or chapter, previewing sample questions without answers and linking to practice sessions.
connectors.use_case: Finding chapter-wise MCQs for an NCERT history textbook, previewing questions before starting a practice set.

connectors.name: VLE Club
connectors.description: Answers questions from Brazilian Portuguese private-practice mentorship lessons for physicians with lesson and minute citations, finds lessons by topic, shows trail progress, and lists the lessons in a trail.
connectors.use_case: Finding what a lesson said about pricing consultations, resuming the next lesson in a practice-growth trail, listing every lesson in a marketing trail.

connectors.name: VnRebates - Học Trading
connectors.description: Finds and runs VnRebates trading quizzes in Vietnamese across technical analysis, macro, forex, gold, crypto and stocks, and grades each answer with an explanation.
connectors.use_case: Taking a 10-question quiz on RSI divergence, reviewing why an ICT order block answer was wrong.

connectors.name: Vokser
connectors.description: Supports manager development by creating and tracking real management challenges with actions, recording behaviour scores and motivators against a development framework, and reporting plan progress and score history.
connectors.use_case: Working through a difficult feedback conversation with a direct report, adding follow-up actions to a challenge, reviewing how behaviour scores changed over a quarter.

connectors.name: WIA Braille + WIA Talk
connectors.description: Converts text to pronunciation-based WIA Braille in 6-dot or 8-dot cells with a quality score, turns braille cells into BRF embosser files and runs automatic checks on BRF text, converts linear math expressions to Nemeth braille, and maps the sounds of a text to and from WIA Talk gesture codes.
connectors.use_case: Converting a short worksheet to WIA Braille and reviewing its quality score, producing a BRF file for an embosser, writing a quadratic equation in Nemeth braille.

connectors.name: WIA Wisdom
connectors.description: Searches a curated collection of 227 English and 227 Korean documents on nine traditions of thought, from dharmic and Abrahamic traditions to modern philosophy and science, returning titles, snippets and source links, fetching document excerpts, and listing the pillars with document counts.
connectors.use_case: Comparing how Buddhist and Hellenic texts treat impermanence, finding a sourced passage on compassion to quote in an essay.

connectors.name: WIHP
connectors.description: Writes foreign words and short sentences in Hangul through a deterministic word-to-IPA-to-Hangul dictionary and rule pipeline, looks up IPA pronunciations for up to 20 words at a time, and lists the 29 supported language and variant codes.
connectors.use_case: Writing a foreign surname in Hangul for a Korean business card, checking the IPA for a list of vocabulary words, preparing a pronunciation guide for Korean learners of another language.

connectors.name: WikiOO Art Search & Quotation
connectors.description: Searches the WikiOO art encyclopedia of artworks, artists, museums and articles, reads details and links, and quotes prices for reproductions.
connectors.use_case: Reading about Monet's Water Lilies and where it hangs, pricing a 50 by 70 cm framed reproduction.

connectors.name: Wondering
connectors.description: Saves study notes and review questions in Wondering, quizzes on due reviews, browses courses, lessons and activity and builds course outlines.
connectors.use_case: Saving five review questions on the Krebs cycle, quizzing on everything due today.

connectors.name: Word Search Builder
connectors.description: Builds a solvable A to Z letter word search from supplied words, up to 30 words on a grid of at most 24 by 24, verifies every word in the finished grid, reports extra accidental occurrences and prints the puzzle with its answer key.
connectors.use_case: Turning a list of words into a printable word search, checking that each word really appears in the grid, printing the puzzle with its answer key.

connectors.name: WordByWord – Learn Languages
connectors.description: Saves new words with translations and example sentences across 50+ languages, tracks known and learning status, builds word collections, quizzes on vocabulary, and reports learning stats.
connectors.use_case: Building a word collection before a trip to Lisbon, marking quizzed words as known, checking how many Italian words are still being learned.

connectors.name: ZIV
connectors.description: Adds English words, phrasal verbs, idioms and phrases to a ZIV vocabulary with Russian translations, skipping duplicates.
connectors.use_case: Saving an unfamiliar word while reading an article, adding an idiom with a custom translation, collecting phrasal verbs from a chat.

connectors.name: Ānayati
connectors.description: Searches the Ānayati course catalogue with previews and language labels, creates an individual course from a goal, starting knowledge, level and topics, and translates eligible English-source courses into French, Spanish, German, Portuguese or Italian, starting creation or translation only after the request and allowance are reviewed and Confirm is clicked, then tracks progress.
connectors.use_case: Creating a course from a learning goal and starting level, translating an English-source course into Spanish after confirming the allowance.
